_comment: Full feed database. Feeds are subscribable content streams that cut ACROSS the channel/doelgroep/skill targeting — the 'declare your interests / subscribe' feature. An article can appear in multiple feeds. Each feed has an icon (KPNicons v2 glyph). type: 'auto' = system-derived, not manually subscribed; 'topic' = freely subscribable; 'org' = organisatiebreed, always on (cannot be unsubscribed, not shown in the Feeds-instellen modal). Topic feeds carry a `group` — the Feeds-instellen modal's section, from the design: 'domeinen' (product/service domains), 'skills' (job competency & growth), 'contenttypes' (media format filters), 'meldingen' (alerts/announcements); an 'Aanbevolen' section is computed at render time (unsubscribed feeds richest in articles), not stored. A user's subscriptions live per-user in users.json.
